lines: Khuli jo aankh to woh tha na woh zamana tha.
couplets.en: I opened my eyes to find him gone and those days gone with him.

lines: Dehakti aag thi, tanhai thi, fasana tha.
couplets.en: A fire still burned, and there was solitude and a story.

lines: Yeh kya ke chand hi qadmon pe thak ke baith gaye?
